title: Power Cut in Berlin - FAQ
subtitle: Katastrophenschutz-Leuchttürme and the January 2026 power cut, checked on 29 October 2026.

items.q: What is a Katastrophenschutz-Leuchtturm in Berlin?
items.a: An emergency point that a district opens in a crisis such as a long power cut, usually in a town hall or district office. Each one offers **an emergency call point, updates on the situation, official advice and information on supplies and help**. They are **not open on normal days**, and each district decides when and where to open them.

items.q: How do I find my nearest emergency point in Berlin?
items.a: Berlin publishes the full list with addresses on berlin.de. The map in this post takes your **postcode** and shows the three nearest points that are **listed as ready**, with a walking time, plus any planned point that is closer.

items.q: How many emergency lighthouses does Berlin have?
items.a: On the list I checked on 29 October 2026: **56 lighthouses, of which 25 are marked ready** to open and 31 are still in planning, plus **17 information points**, all in Reinickendorf.

items.q: How long did the Berlin power cut in January 2026 last?
items.a: The power failed on **Saturday 3 January 2026 at 05:44** in Nikolassee, Zehlendorf, Wannsee and Lichterfelde. Parts of Lichterfelde came back the next day; Stromnetz Berlin reported the supply restored on **Wednesday 7 January at 14:15**, still with some partial outages.

items.q: Does the water stop in a Berlin power cut?
items.a: Not in January 2026. The Beelitzhof waterworks has **its own emergency power**, and the water company brought mobile generators to some sewage pumping stations, so water supply and sewage kept working. Heating on district heating did stop, because its pumps need electricity.

items.q: Do mobile phones work during a power cut in Berlin?
items.a: In January 2026 landlines, mobile phones and the internet **failed inside the dark area**. After **about 48 hours**, mobile masts set up at the edge allowed emergency calls again where the signal reached. Do not plan around your phone.
